---
title: "Cell Type Annotation"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
source("R/read_manifest.R")
source("R/read_summary.R")
source("R/tables.R")
source("R/plot_helpers.R")

result_dir <- get_result_dir("data")
manifest <- read_manifest(result_dir)
annotation_summary <- read_summary_for_step(result_dir, manifest, "annotation")
```

## Annotation Summary

```{r annotation-status, results='asis'}
if (is.null(annotation_summary)) {
  cat("Annotation summary not available.")
} else {
  cat(paste0("Status: **", annotation_summary$status, "**  "))
  cat(paste0("Artifacts: ", annotation_summary$metrics$artifact_count %||% 0))
}
```

## Annotation Plots

```{r annotation-plots, fig.cap="Cell type annotation diagnostics", out.width="48%"}
if (!is.null(annotation_summary)) display_images(result_dir, annotation_summary, max_images = 12)
```

## Annotation Counts

```{r annotation-counts}
counts <- annotation_summary$metrics$annotation_counts
if (!is.null(counts) && length(counts) > 0) {
  for (item in counts) {
    cat("### ", item$column, "\n\n", sep = "")
    count_df <- render_count_table(item$counts)
    if (nrow(count_df) > 0) knitr::kable(count_df, format = "html")
    cat("\n\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("No annotation count columns were found in Cell-cluster-infor.csv.")
}
```

## Annotation Artifacts

```{r annotation-artifacts}
artifacts <- artifact_table(annotation_summary)
if (nrow(artifacts) > 0) {
  knitr::kable(artifacts[, intersect(c("type", "path", "bytes"), colnames(artifacts)), drop = FALSE], format = "html")
} else {
  cat("No annotation artifacts recorded.")
}
```
